summary: Set up a new account for Priya Nair (Accounting, starts Monday 2026-10-12) with the same access as Marcus Webb. Taylor Garcia sent the request and is an approved requester for onboarding and spending. Nobody named Priya or Nair exists in the directory, active or disabled, so this isn't a rehire. Marcus has Microsoft 365 Business Premium (SPB, skuId cbdc14ab-d96c-4c30-b9f4-6ada7cdc1d46), which includes Office and Teams. All 25 SPB seats are in use, so the plan buys 1 more. 11 disabled 'Seat Holder' placeholder accounts are each holding an SPB seat, which a technician could look at instead of buying. The plan creates the account as priya.nair@ with usageLocation US. It adds her to the three groups that can be changed through Graph: Northwind Parking, Accounting and Finance Files. It also creates a temporary access pass (TAP) that only works from Monday morning, and schedules the license to be assigned early Monday. The distribution list, the hosted desktop (RDS-Users) and the VPN (VPN-Users) go to a technician now. The VPN also needs Marlene's approval.
assumptions: Peer is Marcus Webb (8a590663-09f2-4ee8-ab1a-6195ca3943f9), Senior Accountant in Accounting. He is the only Marcus in the directory.
'Monday' means 2026-10-12. Times are in UTC, aimed at early-morning US hours: license at 10:00Z, TAP valid 11:00Z to 23:00Z.
'office + teams' is covered by mirroring Marcus's Business Premium (SPB) license.
No privileged or admin groups were found among Marcus's groups, and no directory roles are being assigned.
RDS-Users and VPN-Users are left out of the Graph steps. They're treated as markers for access outside Graph and handed to a technician (VPN needs Marlene's approval).

content.notes: Sign in at office.com with priya.nair@NorthwindParking.onmicrosoft.com and the temporary access pass, valid Monday 2026-10-12 only, then set up the Microsoft Authenticator app. On a phone, use the Outlook mobile app: the built-in iOS Mail app can show 'needs admin approval'. Accounting files are in the Accounting team in Teams and SharePoint. Hosted desktop and VPN access are being set up separately.

steps.rationale: Get the credentials to the requester safely through a one-time link. The TAP is never sent in plain email.
